_comment: All heuristic thresholds, penalties and score weights - configurable per non-functional requirement 5 (Maintainability). Change values here, no code change needed.

riskLevels._escalationComment: A weighted average dilutes a single decisive signal: priceRisk 100 x 0.25 = 25 ('Low'), and a proven Tampered asset (authRisk 100 x 0.40 = 40) is only 'Medium'. Each curve maps that indicator's value -> a minimum unified score, interpolated between anchor points [indicatorValue, floor]; the final score is max(weighted, highest floor). Curves are per-indicator because the same number means different things: fraud 90 is two self-transfers (routine on mainnet), price 90 is a listing at ~5x the collection median. Remove a curve to disable escalation for that indicator.
